assets.projectionEvidence: BMNG dataset user manual section1.1: geographic Plate Carrée, equal latitude-longitude grid spacing, WGS84. Table1: full globe 180W/90N to 180E/90S.

implementationNotes: Use SphereGeometry UV coordinates with an ordinary TextureLoader map and sRGB color space; these are surface maps, not full-sky environment maps.
Use the verified equirectangular map instead of the Apollo17 disc photograph.
The 2048 version is light enough for modest GPUs. The 5400 version has greater surface detail; choose according to renderer maximum texture size.
These historical composites do not resolve individual San Francisco buildings; transition to an appropriately georeferenced aerial image for city detail.
